fixes.key: %@ may be signed out or not running.
fixes.english: %@ may be signed out or not running.
fixes.before: %@ mungkin sudah keluar atau tidak berjalan.
fixes.after: %@ mungkin sudah keluar dari akun atau tidak berjalan.
fixes.why: meaning: keluar alone reads as quit; signed out is keluar dari akun

fixes.key: %@ remaining in total
fixes.english: %@ remaining in total
fixes.before: %@ tersisa secara total
fixes.after: Total %@ tersisa
fixes.why: natural: secara total reads as completely; Total ... tersisa matches the time bar string

fixes.key: %@ wasn't asked for again, because the drive hasn't answered an earlier read
fixes.english: %@ wasn't asked for again, because the drive hasn't answered an earlier read
fixes.before: %@ tidak diminta lagi, karena drive belum menjawab pembacaan sebelumnya
fixes.after: %@ tidak diminta lagi, karena drive belum merespons pembacaan sebelumnya
fixes.why: natural: a drive merespons, it does not menjawab

fixes.key: %@ wasn't downloaded
fixes.english: %@ wasn't downloaded
fixes.before: %@ tidak diunduh
fixes.after: %@ gagal diunduh
fixes.why: meaning: tidak diunduh says nobody tried; the download failed

fixes.key: %lld books weren't downloaded: %@
fixes.why: meaning: tidak diunduh says nobody tried; the download failed

fixes.key: A destination folder path is invalid.
fixes.english: A destination folder path is invalid.
fixes.before: Path folder tujuan tidak valid.
fixes.after: Jalur folder tujuan tidak valid.
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian says jalur for a path, not the English word

fixes.key: A folder name can't be empty, "." or "..", end in ".tmb", or be reserved by TextMouth.
fixes.english: A folder name can't be empty, "." or "..", end in ".tmb", or be reserved by TextMouth.
fixes.before: Nama folder tidak boleh kosong, "." atau "..", diakhiri dengan ".tmb", atau dicadangkan oleh TextMouth.
fixes.after: Nama folder tidak boleh kosong, berupa “.” atau “..”, berakhiran “.tmb”, atau dicadangkan oleh TextMouth.
fixes.why: grammar: the list lacked a verb before the names; curly quotes as the glossary sets

fixes.key: A move shifts one book at a time, and several are selected. Select one book, then try again.
fixes.english: A move shifts one book at a time, and several are selected. Select one book, then try again.
fixes.before: Pemindahan menggeser satu buku sekaligus, dan beberapa buku dipilih. Pilih satu buku, lalu coba lagi.
fixes.after: Buku dipindahkan satu per satu, sedangkan beberapa buku sedang dipilih. Pilih satu buku, lalu coba lagi.
fixes.why: natural: satu buku sekaligus says one book all at once; satu per satu is one at a time

fixes.key: Add gesture step
fixes.english: Add gesture step
fixes.before: Tambah langkah gestur
fixes.after: Tambah langkah gerakan
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian calls a gesture gerakan (trackpad, AssistiveTouch)

fixes.key: Appends a new step to the gesture sequence
fixes.english: Appends a new step to the gesture sequence
fixes.before: Menambahkan langkah baru di akhir urutan gestur.
fixes.after: Menambahkan langkah baru di akhir urutan gerakan.
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian calls a gesture gerakan (trackpad, AssistiveTouch)

fixes.key: Books can't be moved in this view. Go to a folder in Folders, or to the Reading List, then try again.
fixes.english: Books can't be moved in this view. Go to a folder in Folders, or to the Reading List, then try again.
fixes.before: Buku tidak dapat dipindahkan dalam tampilan ini. Buka folder di Folder atau Daftar Bacaan, lalu coba lagi.
fixes.after: Buku tidak dapat dipindahkan dalam tampilan ini. Buka folder di tampilan Folder, atau buka Daftar Bacaan, lalu coba lagi.
fixes.why: meaning: the old text read as a folder inside the Reading List; two separate places now

fixes.key: Choose no per-book control, one shared picker, or a menu with separate forward and backward pickers
fixes.english: Choose no per-book control, one shared picker, or a menu with separate forward and backward pickers
fixes.before: Memilih tanpa kontrol per buku, satu pemilih bersama, atau menu dengan pemilih maju dan mundur terpisah.
fixes.after: Memilih antara tidak ada kontrol per buku, satu pemilih bersama, atau menu dengan pemilih maju dan mundur yang terpisah.
fixes.why: meaning: Memilih tanpa read as choose without; the three choices are now a list

fixes.key: Choose where to move the books and subfolders before deleting "%@".
fixes.english: Choose where to move the books and subfolders before deleting "%@".
fixes.before: Pilih tujuan untuk memindahkan buku dan subfolder sebelum menghapus "%@".
fixes.after: Pilih tujuan untuk memindahkan buku dan subfolder sebelum menghapus “%@”.
fixes.why: punctuation: curly quotes as the glossary sets

fixes.key: Condition %@ days
fixes.english: Condition %@ days
fixes.before: Kondisi %@ hari
fixes.after: Hari kondisi %@
fixes.why: meaning: a number before a noun reads as a count (2 hari is two days); the field name now comes first

fixes.key: Condition %@ folder
fixes.english: Condition %@ folder
fixes.before: Kondisi %@ folder
fixes.after: Folder kondisi %@
fixes.why: meaning: a number before a noun reads as a count (2 hari is two days); the field name now comes first

fixes.key: Condition %@ format
fixes.english: Condition %@ format
fixes.before: Kondisi %@ format
fixes.after: Format kondisi %@
fixes.why: meaning: a number before a noun reads as a count (2 hari is two days); the field name now comes first

fixes.key: Condition %@ reading state
fixes.english: Condition %@ reading state
fixes.before: Kondisi %@ status baca
fixes.after: Status baca kondisi %@
fixes.why: meaning: a number before a noun reads as a count (2 hari is two days); the field name now comes first

fixes.key: Condition %@ relation
fixes.english: Condition %@ relation
fixes.before: Kondisi %@ relasi
fixes.after: Relasi kondisi %@
fixes.why: meaning: a number before a noun reads as a count (2 hari is two days); the field name now comes first

fixes.key: Condition %@ text
fixes.english: Condition %@ text
fixes.before: Kondisi %@ teks
fixes.after: Teks kondisi %@
fixes.why: meaning: a number before a noun reads as a count (2 hari is two days); the field name now comes first

fixes.key: Copy all TextMouth data to %@, validate it, and use the new location?
fixes.english: Copy all TextMouth data to %@, validate it, and use the new location?
fixes.before: Salin semua data TextMouth ke %@, validasi, dan gunakan lokasi baru?
fixes.after: Salin semua data TextMouth ke %@, validasikan, dan gunakan lokasi baru?
fixes.why: grammar: validasi is a noun in a row of commands; the verb is validasikan

fixes.key: Could not delete "%@" and move its contents
fixes.english: Could not delete "%@" and move its contents
fixes.before: Tidak dapat menghapus "%@" dan memindahkan isinya
fixes.after: Tidak dapat menghapus “%@” dan memindahkan isinya
fixes.why: punctuation: curly quotes as the glossary sets

fixes.key: Could not move "%@"
fixes.english: Could not move "%@"
fixes.before: Tidak dapat memindahkan "%@"
fixes.after: Tidak dapat memindahkan “%@”
fixes.why: punctuation: curly quotes as the glossary sets

fixes.key: Could not remove folder: its library path is invalid or has changed.
fixes.english: Could not remove folder: its library path is invalid or has changed.
fixes.before: Tidak dapat membuang folder: path pustakanya tidak valid atau telah berubah.
fixes.after: Tidak dapat membuang folder: jalur pustakanya tidak valid atau telah berubah.
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian says jalur for a path, not the English word

fixes.key: Could not rename "%@"
fixes.english: Could not rename "%@"
fixes.before: Tidak dapat mengganti nama "%@"
fixes.after: Tidak dapat mengganti nama “%@”
fixes.why: punctuation: curly quotes as the glossary sets

fixes.key: Duplicate
fixes.english: Duplicate
fixes.before: Duplikat
fixes.after: Duplikatkan
fixes.why: term: a command; Apple Indonesian Duplicate is the verb Duplikatkan, Duplikat is the noun

fixes.key: Enable restart-timer gesture
fixes.english: Enable restart-timer gesture
fixes.before: Aktifkan gestur timer ulang
fixes.after: Aktifkan gerakan mulai ulang timer
fixes.why: meaning: timer ulang reads as a repeat timer; the gesture restarts the timer; gerakan as Apple says

fixes.key: Enter or paste the text for the new book
fixes.english: Enter or paste the text for the new book
fixes.before: Memasukkan atau menempel teks untuk buku baru.
fixes.after: Menerima teks yang Anda ketik atau tempel untuk buku baru.
fixes.why: natural: the hint had the text area doing the entering; it now says what it takes

fixes.key: Feeds are always listed by title
fixes.english: Feeds are always listed by title
fixes.before: Feed selalu didaftar menurut judul.
fixes.after: Feed selalu diurutkan menurut judul.
fixes.why: natural: didaftar reads as registered; the hint means sorted by title

fixes.key: Feeds are listed by title
fixes.english: Feeds are listed by title
fixes.before: Feed didaftar menurut judul
fixes.after: Feed diurutkan menurut judul
fixes.why: natural: didaftar reads as registered; the value means sorted by title

fixes.key: Gesture pattern
fixes.english: Gesture pattern
fixes.before: Pola gestur
fixes.after: Pola gerakan
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian calls a gesture gerakan (trackpad, AssistiveTouch)

fixes.key: Gesture time window
fixes.english: Gesture time window
fixes.before: Jendela waktu gestur
fixes.after: Jangka waktu gerakan
fixes.why: meaning: Jendela is the app word for a window; jangka waktu as the explanation says; gerakan as Apple says

fixes.key: Hold Shift while skipping to use a secondary skip amount.
fixes.english: Hold Shift while skipping to use a secondary skip amount.
fixes.before: Tahan Shift saat melompati untuk memakai jumlah lompatan kedua.
fixes.after: Tahan Shift saat melompat untuk memakai jumlah lompatan kedua.
fixes.why: grammar: melompati needs an object; a skip in audio is melompat

fixes.key: How long media commands are blocked after a Bluetooth device disconnects. Raise it if playback resumes after removing headphones.
fixes.english: How long media commands are blocked after a Bluetooth device disconnects. Raise it if playback resumes after removing headphones.
fixes.before: Berapa lama perintah media diblokir setelah perangkat Bluetooth terputus. Naikkan jika pemutaran lanjut setelah headphone dilepas.
fixes.after: Berapa lama perintah media diblokir setelah perangkat Bluetooth terputus. Naikkan jika pemutaran berlanjut setelah headphone dilepas.
fixes.why: grammar: lanjut alone is colloquial; the verb is berlanjut

fixes.key: If the file arrives from %@ later, it names the same library.
fixes.english: If the file arrives from %@ later, it names the same library.
fixes.before: Jika file tiba dari %@ nanti, file itu menamai pustaka yang sama.
fixes.after: Jika file tiba dari %@ nanti, file itu merujuk ke pustaka yang sama.
fixes.why: meaning: menamai is to give a name; the file refers to the library

fixes.key: It may be paused, signed out, or not running.
fixes.english: It may be paused, signed out, or not running.
fixes.before: Mungkin dijeda, sudah keluar, atau tidak berjalan.
fixes.after: Mungkin dijeda, sudah keluar dari akun, atau tidak berjalan.
fixes.why: meaning: keluar alone reads as quit; signed out is keluar dari akun

fixes.key: Leading articles
fixes.english: Leading articles
fixes.before: Artikel di awal
fixes.after: Kata sandang di awal
fixes.why: meaning: artikel is a news article in this app; The, A, and An are kata sandang

fixes.key: Media-control events that trigger the restart. The last one is consumed, not passed to playback, so it can't start audio.
fixes.english: Media-control events that trigger the restart. The last one is consumed, not passed to playback, so it can't start audio.
fixes.before: Peristiwa kontrol media yang memicu pengulangan. Yang terakhir dikonsumsi, tidak diteruskan ke pemutaran, jadi tidak dapat memulai audio.
fixes.after: Peristiwa kontrol media yang memicu mulai ulang. Yang terakhir ditahan dan tidak diteruskan ke pemutaran, jadi tidak dapat memulai audio.
fixes.why: meaning: pengulangan is repetition, not a restart; dikonsumsi is a calque of consumed

fixes.key: Most rows shown
fixes.english: Most rows shown
fixes.before: Baris terbanyak yang ditampilkan
fixes.after: Jumlah baris maksimum
fixes.why: natural: Baris terbanyak reads as the rows with the most; the field is the largest number of rows

fixes.key: Move "%@"
fixes.english: Move "%@"
fixes.before: Pindahkan "%@"
fixes.after: Pindahkan “%@”
fixes.why: punctuation: curly quotes as the glossary sets

fixes.key: Move Contents Out
fixes.english: Move Contents Out
fixes.before: Pindahkan Isi Keluar
fixes.after: Pindahkan Isi ke Luar
fixes.why: grammar: keluar is the verb to exit; the direction is ke luar

fixes.key: Move Contents of "%@"
fixes.english: Move Contents of "%@"
fixes.before: Pindahkan Isi "%@"
fixes.after: Pindahkan Isi “%@”
fixes.why: punctuation: curly quotes as the glossary sets

fixes.key: Neither has newer places or books the other lacks, but they differ in other ways.
fixes.english: Neither has newer places or books the other lacks, but they differ in other ways.
fixes.before: Tidak ada yang memiliki posisi atau buku lebih baru yang tidak dimiliki salinan lain, tetapi keduanya berbeda dengan cara lain.
fixes.after: Tidak ada salinan yang memiliki posisi lebih baru atau buku yang tidak dimiliki salinan lain, tetapi keduanya berbeda dalam hal lain.
fixes.why: natural: lebih baru had joined books; berbeda dalam hal lain is the idiom for differ in other ways

fixes.key: Not Within the Last
fixes.english: Not Within the Last
fixes.before: Tidak dalam
fixes.after: Tidak Dalam
fixes.why: natural: title case like its sibling items Dalam and Tidak Berisi

fixes.key: Paste from Clipboard
fixes.english: Paste from Clipboard
fixes.before: Tempel dari Clipboard
fixes.after: Tempel dari Papan Klip
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian calls the clipboard Papan Klip, as other strings here do

fixes.key: Replaces the text with the text on the clipboard
fixes.english: Replaces the text with the text on the clipboard
fixes.before: Mengganti teks dengan teks di clipboard.
fixes.after: Mengganti teks dengan teks di papan klip.
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian calls the clipboard papan klip, as other strings here do

fixes.key: Restart Sleep Timer Gesture
fixes.english: Restart Sleep Timer Gesture
fixes.before: Gestur Mulai Ulang Timer Tidur
fixes.after: Gerakan Mulai Ulang Timer Tidur
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian calls a gesture gerakan (trackpad, AssistiveTouch)

fixes.key: Results copied to the clipboard.
fixes.english: Results copied to the clipboard.
fixes.before: Hasil disalin ke clipboard.
fixes.after: Hasil disalin ke papan klip.
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian calls the clipboard papan klip, as other strings here do

fixes.key: Searches the entire library for books matching the selected criteria
fixes.english: Searches the entire library for books matching the selected criteria
fixes.before: Mencari di seluruh pustaka buku yang cocok dengan kriteria terpilih.
fixes.after: Mencari buku yang cocok dengan kriteria terpilih di seluruh pustaka.
fixes.why: natural: seluruh pustaka buku read as the whole book library; the place now ends the sentence

fixes.key: Show Always
fixes.english: Show Always
fixes.before: Tampilkan Selalu
fixes.after: Selalu Tampilkan
fixes.why: natural: Indonesian puts selalu before the verb

fixes.key: Some files of “%@” are only in the cloud, and replacing it now would leave them behind. Download the book, then choose %@ again.
fixes.english: Some files of “%1$@” are only in the cloud, and replacing it now would leave them behind. Download the book, then choose %2$@ again.
fixes.before: Beberapa file “%@” hanya ada di cloud, dan menggantinya sekarang akan meninggalkannya. Unduh buku, lalu pilih %@ lagi.
fixes.after: Beberapa file “%@” hanya ada di cloud, dan jika buku diganti sekarang, file itu akan tertinggal. Unduh buku, lalu pilih %@ lagi.
fixes.why: natural: two -nya made it unclear what leaves what behind

fixes.key: Still comparing: %lld seconds so far. Press Escape to stop.

english.one: Still comparing: %lld second so far. Press Escape to stop.
english.other: Still comparing: %lld seconds so far. Press Escape to stop.

before.other: Masih membandingkan: sejauh ini %lld detik. Tekan Escape untuk menghentikan.

after.other: Masih membandingkan: sejauh ini %lld detik. Tekan Escape untuk menghentikannya.

fixes.why: grammar: menghentikan needs an object

fixes.key: Stops playback resuming when headphones disconnect
fixes.english: Stops playback resuming when headphones disconnect
fixes.before: Menghentikan pemutaran yang berlanjut saat headphone terputus.
fixes.after: Mencegah pemutaran berlanjut sendiri saat headphone terputus.
fixes.why: meaning: the old hint stopped playback that goes on; the switch prevents playback from resuming

fixes.key: Take it off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options first.
fixes.english: Take it off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options first.
fixes.before: Keluarkan dari daftar bacaan, atau kosongkan %@ di opsi Daftar Bacaan dulu.
fixes.after: Keluarkan dari daftar bacaan, atau matikan %@ di opsi Daftar Bacaan dulu.
fixes.why: meaning: %@ is an option, so clear is to switch it off, not kosongkan (empty)

fixes.key: TextMouth is already moving its data directory.
fixes.english: TextMouth is already moving its data directory.
fixes.before: TextMouth sudah memindahkan folder datanya.
fixes.after: TextMouth sedang memindahkan folder datanya.
fixes.why: meaning: sudah memindahkan says the move is done; it is still under way

fixes.key: The braille is translated to print again with this code. Nothing checks that it is the right choice. If words read wrongly, choose another.
fixes.english: The braille is translated to print again with this code. Nothing checks that it is the right choice. If words read wrongly, choose another.
fixes.before: Braille diterjemahkan ke cetak lagi dengan kode ini. Tidak ada yang memeriksa apakah ini pilihan yang benar. Jika kata terbaca salah, pilih yang lain.
fixes.after: Braille diterjemahkan ulang ke teks cetak dengan kode ini. Tidak ada yang memeriksa apakah ini pilihan yang benar. Jika kata terbaca salah, pilih yang lain.
fixes.why: natural: ke cetak alone is not a noun for print text

fixes.key: The clipboard has no text to paste, so the text is unchanged.
fixes.english: The clipboard has no text to paste, so the text is unchanged.
fixes.before: Clipboard tidak berisi teks untuk ditempel, jadi teks tidak berubah.
fixes.after: Papan klip tidak berisi teks untuk ditempel, jadi teks tidak berubah.
fixes.why: term: Apple Indonesian calls the clipboard papan klip, as other strings here do

fixes.key: The most time the whole sequence may take. Shorter windows mean fewer accidental matches but quicker presses.
fixes.english: The most time the whole sequence may take. Shorter windows mean fewer accidental matches but quicker presses.
fixes.before: Waktu terlama yang boleh dipakai seluruh urutan. Jendela yang lebih pendek berarti lebih sedikit kecocokan tidak sengaja tetapi penekanan harus lebih cepat.
fixes.after: Waktu terlama yang boleh dipakai seluruh urutan. Jangka waktu yang lebih pendek berarti lebih sedikit kecocokan tidak sengaja, tetapi penekanan harus lebih cepat.
fixes.why: meaning: Jendela is the app word for a window; jangka waktu as the explanation of the setting says

fixes.key: The view is first in the list.
fixes.english: The view is first in the list.
fixes.before: Tampilan ini pertama dalam daftar.
fixes.after: Tampilan ini berada di urutan pertama dalam daftar.
fixes.why: grammar: pertama cannot stand as the predicate alone

fixes.key: The view is last in the list.
fixes.english: The view is last in the list.
fixes.before: Tampilan ini terakhir dalam daftar.
fixes.after: Tampilan ini berada di urutan terakhir dalam daftar.
fixes.why: grammar: terakhir cannot stand as the predicate alone

fixes.key: Then take it off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options.
fixes.english: Then take it off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options.
fixes.before: Lalu keluarkan dari daftar bacaan, atau kosongkan %@ di opsi Daftar Bacaan.
fixes.after: Lalu keluarkan dari daftar bacaan, atau matikan %@ di opsi Daftar Bacaan.
fixes.why: meaning: %@ is an option, so clear is to switch it off, not kosongkan (empty)

fixes.key: Time window
fixes.english: Time window
fixes.before: Jendela waktu
fixes.after: Jangka waktu
fixes.why: meaning: Jendela is the app word for a window; jangka waktu as the explanation of the setting says

fixes.key: Time window: %@
fixes.english: Time window: %@
fixes.before: Jendela waktu: %@
fixes.after: Jangka waktu: %@
fixes.why: meaning: Jendela is the app word for a window; jangka waktu as the explanation of the setting says

fixes.key: To let it go, take it off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options.
fixes.english: To let it go, take it off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options.
fixes.before: Untuk melepasnya, keluarkan dari daftar bacaan, atau kosongkan %@ di opsi Daftar Bacaan.
fixes.after: Untuk melepasnya, keluarkan dari daftar bacaan, atau matikan %@ di opsi Daftar Bacaan.
fixes.why: meaning: %@ is an option, so clear is to switch it off, not kosongkan (empty)

fixes.key: To let them go, take them off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options.
fixes.english: To let them go, take them off the reading list, or clear %@ in the Reading List's options.
fixes.before: Untuk melepasnya, keluarkan dari daftar bacaan, atau kosongkan %@ di opsi Daftar Bacaan.
fixes.after: Untuk melepasnya, keluarkan dari daftar bacaan, atau matikan %@ di opsi Daftar Bacaan.
fixes.why: meaning: %@ is an option, so clear is to switch it off, not kosongkan (empty)

fixes.key: Type to search the book's transcript
fixes.english: Type to search the book's transcript
fixes.before: Mengetik untuk mencari di transkrip buku.
fixes.after: Mencari di transkrip buku saat Anda mengetik.
fixes.why: natural: Mengetik untuk mencari had the field doing the typing; the hint now says the result

fixes.key: Type to search the text of every book in the library
fixes.english: Type to search the text of every book in the library
fixes.before: Mengetik untuk mencari teks setiap buku di pustaka.
fixes.after: Mencari teks setiap buku di pustaka saat Anda mengetik.
fixes.why: natural: Mengetik untuk mencari had the field doing the typing; the hint now says the result

fixes.key: Type to search within the book
fixes.english: Type to search within the book
fixes.before: Mengetik untuk mencari di dalam buku.
fixes.after: Mencari di dalam buku saat Anda mengetik.
fixes.why: natural: Mengetik untuk mencari had the field doing the typing; the hint now says the result

fixes.key: Unread: %@ wasn't asked for again, because the drive hasn't answered an earlier read, %@
fixes.english: Unread: %1$@ wasn't asked for again, because the drive hasn't answered an earlier read, %2$@
fixes.before: Tidak terbaca: %@ tidak diminta lagi, karena drive belum menjawab pembacaan sebelumnya, %@
fixes.after: Tidak terbaca: %@ tidak diminta lagi, karena drive belum merespons pembacaan sebelumnya, %@
fixes.why: natural: a drive merespons, it does not menjawab

fixes.key: What happens when a book finishes playing
fixes.english: What happens when a book finishes playing
fixes.before: Apa yang terjadi saat buku selesai diputar.
fixes.after: Memilih apa yang terjadi saat buku selesai diputar.
fixes.why: voiceover: the hint was a noun phrase; it is now a sentence that starts with a verb

fixes.key: What happens when you hold Shift and skip backward
fixes.english: What happens when you hold Shift and skip backward
fixes.before: Apa yang terjadi saat Anda menahan Shift dan melompat mundur.
fixes.after: Memilih apa yang terjadi saat Anda menahan Shift dan melompat mundur.

fixes.english: Recording to insert at %1$@, from %2$@, after the beep. Punch In or Stop ends it; Clear Selection discards it.
fixes.before: Merekam untuk disisipkan pada %1$@, dari %2$@, setelah bunyi bip. Rekam Menimpa atau Berhenti mengakhirinya; Kosongkan Pilihan membuangnya.
fixes.after: Merekam untuk disisipkan pada %1$@, dari %2$@, setelah bunyi bip. Rekam Menimpa atau Berhenti untuk mengakhirinya; Kosongkan Pilihan untuk membuangnya.
fixes.why: natural: Berhenti mengakhirinya reads as stop ending it; X untuk Y names each command and what it does

fixes.key: Records over the selection, or at the cursor, after a beep. Again, or Stop, ends it.
fixes.english: Records over the selection, or at the cursor, after a beep. Again, or Stop, ends it.
fixes.before: Merekam menimpa pilihan, atau di posisi kursor, setelah bunyi bip. Tekan lagi, atau Berhenti, untuk mengakhirinya.
fixes.after: Merekam menimpa pilihan, atau di posisi kursor, setelah bunyi bip. Pilih lagi, atau Berhenti, untuk mengakhirinya.
fixes.why: voiceover: tekan names a press; the English says choosing it again, or Stop, ends it

fixes.key: Replaced %@ with %@ of new recording, which is selected.
fixes.english: Replaced %1$@ with %2$@ of new recording, which is selected.

fixes.after: %1$@ diganti dengan rekaman baru berdurasi %2$@ yang kini terpilih.
fixes.why: meaning: sedang dipilih says it is being chosen; the new recording is now selected

fixes.english: Resubscribed to %@. Checking it now…

fixes.after: Berhasil berlangganan %@ lagi. Memeriksanya sekarang…
fixes.why: meaning: Berlangganan %@ is the Subscribe button label word for word; the announcement says the subscription is made

fixes.key: Reverted to the original audio. Redo brings back the %lld edits.

english.one: Reverted to the original audio. Redo brings back the %lld edit.
english.other: Reverted to the original audio. Redo brings back the %lld edits.

before.other: Dikembalikan ke audio asli semula. Ulangi mengembalikan %lld edit.

after.other: Dikembalikan ke audio asli semula. Pilih Ulangi untuk mengembalikan %lld edit.

fixes.why: natural: a one-word command name as the subject reads as the command itself; the sentence says what choosing it does

fixes.key: Seconds between level announcements
fixes.english: Seconds between level announcements
fixes.before: Detik antar pengumuman level
fixes.after: Detik antarpengumuman level
fixes.why: punctuation: antar is a bound form and joins its noun, as antarpenyegaran does elsewhere

fixes.english: Sets the transcription language. A language marked needs download downloads only from the Transcribe Audio sheet.
fixes.before: Mengatur bahasa transkripsi. Bahasa yang ditandai perlu diunduh hanya dapat diunduh dari lembar Transkripsikan Audio.
fixes.after: Mengatur bahasa transkripsi. Bahasa yang ditandai “perlu diunduh” hanya dapat diunduh dari lembar Transkripsikan Audio.
fixes.why: meaning: without quotation marks the status word perlu diunduh ran into the sentence and garbled it

fixes.key: Still working. Close once the change is done.
fixes.english: Still working. Close once the change is done.

fixes.after: Masih memproses. Tutup setelah perubahan selesai.
fixes.why: natural: masih bekerja is a person at work; the app says masih memproses, as the line before does

fixes.key: Subscribed to %@. This feed uses plain http, so others can read or change what it sends; TextMouth still loads it.
fixes.english: Subscribed to %@. This feed uses plain http, so others can read or change what it sends; TextMouth still loads it.
fixes.before: Berlangganan %@. Feed ini memakai http biasa, sehingga orang lain dapat membaca atau mengubah apa yang dikirimnya; TextMouth tetap memuatnya.
fixes.after: Berhasil berlangganan %@. Feed ini memakai http biasa, sehingga orang lain dapat membaca atau mengubah apa yang dikirimnya; TextMouth tetap memuatnya.
fixes.why: meaning: Berlangganan %@ is the Subscribe button label word for word; the announcement says the subscription is made

fixes.key: TextMouth cannot open copy-protected files.
fixes.english: TextMouth cannot open copy-protected files.
fixes.before: TextMouth tidak dapat membuka file yang dilindungi hak cipta.
fixes.after: TextMouth tidak dapat membuka file yang dilindungi dari penyalinan.
fixes.why: meaning: dilindungi hak cipta means copyrighted, which nearly every book is; copy-protected is dilindungi dari penyalinan

fixes.key: TextMouth downloads %lld of them again at their feeds' next checks, or the next time it opens.

english.one: TextMouth downloads %lld of them again at their feeds' next checks, or the next time it opens.
english.other: TextMouth downloads %lld of them again at their feeds' next checks, or the next time it opens.

before.other: TextMouth mengunduh ulang %lld di antaranya pada pemeriksaan berikutnya feed-nya, atau saat TextMouth dibuka lagi.

after.other: TextMouth mengunduh ulang %lld di antaranya pada pemeriksaan feed-nya yang berikutnya, atau saat TextMouth dibuka lagi.

fixes.why: grammar: the possessor goes before berikutnya; pemeriksaan berikutnya feed-nya is out of order

fixes.key: TextMouth downloads 1 of them again at its feed's next check, or the next time it opens.
fixes.english: TextMouth downloads 1 of them again at its feed's next check, or the next time it opens.
fixes.before: TextMouth mengunduh ulang 1 di antaranya pada pemeriksaan berikutnya feed-nya, atau saat TextMouth dibuka lagi.
fixes.after: TextMouth mengunduh ulang 1 di antaranya pada pemeriksaan feed-nya yang berikutnya, atau saat TextMouth dibuka lagi.
fixes.why: grammar: the possessor goes before berikutnya; pemeriksaan berikutnya feed-nya is out of order

fixes.key: TextMouth is quitting and the book's audio doesn't hold these edits yet. Discard undoes them; next time you edit this book, Redo brings them back until you make another edit. Cancel keeps TextMouth open.
fixes.english: TextMouth is quitting and the book's audio doesn't hold these edits yet. Discard undoes them; next time you edit this book, Redo brings them back until you make another edit. Cancel keeps TextMouth open.
fixes.before: TextMouth akan keluar dan audio buku belum memuat edit ini. Buang mengurungkannya; saat Anda mengedit buku ini lagi, Ulangi mengembalikannya sampai Anda melakukan edit lain. Batal membiarkan TextMouth tetap terbuka.
fixes.after: TextMouth akan keluar dan audio buku belum memuat edit ini. Pilih Buang untuk mengurungkannya; saat Anda mengedit buku ini lagi, pilih Ulangi untuk mengembalikannya sebelum Anda melakukan edit lain. Pilih Batal agar TextMouth tetap terbuka.
fixes.why: natural: a one-word command name as the subject reads as the command itself; the sentence says what choosing it does

fixes.key: TextMouth isn't allowed to post notifications. Turn them on in System Settings, Notifications, TextMouth.
fixes.english: TextMouth isn't allowed to post notifications. Turn them on in System Settings, Notifications, TextMouth.
fixes.before: TextMouth tidak diizinkan menampilkan notifikasi. Aktifkan di Pengaturan Sistem, Notifikasi, TextMouth.
fixes.after: TextMouth tidak diizinkan menampilkan notifikasi. Aktifkan di Pengaturan Sistem, Pemberitahuan, TextMouth.
fixes.why: term: Apple names the System Settings pane Pemberitahuan; a listener looking for Notifikasi will not find it

fixes.key: The disk is too full to keep this audio for pasting.
fixes.english: The disk is too full to keep this audio for pasting.
fixes.before: Disk terlalu penuh untuk menyimpan audio ini untuk ditempel.
fixes.after: Disk terlalu penuh untuk menyimpan audio ini agar dapat ditempel.
fixes.why: natural: two untuk in a row; agar dapat ditempel, as the catalog says elsewhere

fixes.key: The original is the lossless take a recording is saved from, or a copy of an audiobook's file from before its first edit. Keeping it lets every edit be undone without loss; a recording's costs about 345 MB an hour. A change also applies to originals already kept, and in a cloud library an original syncs with its book.
fixes.english: The original is the lossless take a recording is saved from, or a copy of an audiobook's file from before its first edit. Keeping it lets every edit be undone without loss; a recording's costs about 345 MB an hour. A change also applies to originals already kept, and in a cloud library an original syncs with its book.
fixes.before: Audio asli adalah hasil rekaman tanpa kehilangan kualitas tempat sebuah rekaman disimpan, atau salinan file buku audio dari sebelum edit pertamanya. Dengan mempertahankannya, setiap edit dapat diurungkan tanpa kehilangan kualitas; audio asli rekaman memakan sekitar 345 MB per jam. Perubahan juga berlaku untuk audio asli yang sudah dipertahankan, dan di pustaka cloud, audio asli ikut tersinkron dengan bukunya.
fixes.after: Audio asli adalah rekaman mentah tanpa kehilangan kualitas yang menjadi sumber rekaman saat disimpan, atau salinan file buku audio dari sebelum edit pertamanya. Dengan mempertahankannya, setiap edit dapat diurungkan tanpa kehilangan kualitas; audio asli rekaman memakan sekitar 345 MB per jam. Perubahan juga berlaku untuk audio asli yang sudah dipertahankan, dan di pustaka cloud, audio asli ikut tersinkron dengan bukunya.
fixes.why: meaning: tempat sebuah rekaman disimpan said where a recording is stored; the take is what the recording is saved from

fixes.key: The podcast directory at %@ couldn't answer the search (error %@). Try again later.
fixes.english: The podcast directory at %1$@ couldn't answer the search (error %2$@). Try again later.
fixes.before: Direktori podcast di %1$@ tidak dapat menjawab pencarian (galat %2$@). Coba lagi nanti.
fixes.after: Direktori podcast di %1$@ tidak dapat memproses pencarian (kesalahan %2$@). Coba lagi nanti.
fixes.why: term: kesalahan for error as everywhere else, and a server memproses a search rather than menjawab it

fixes.key: The podcast directory at %@ didn't answer for %lld seconds.

english.one: The podcast directory at %@ didn't answer for %lld second.
english.other: The podcast directory at %@ didn't answer for %lld seconds.

before.other: Direktori podcast di %1$@ tidak menjawab selama %2$lld detik.

after.other: Direktori podcast di %1$@ tidak merespons selama %2$lld detik.

fixes.why: natural: a server that times out tidak merespons; menjawab is a person answering

fixes.key: The podcast directory couldn't answer the search. Try again later.
fixes.english: The podcast directory couldn't answer the search. Try again later.
fixes.before: Direktori podcast tidak dapat menjawab pencarian. Coba lagi nanti.
fixes.after: Direktori podcast tidak dapat memproses pencarian. Coba lagi nanti.
fixes.why: natural: a server memproses a search; menjawab pencarian reads as a person answering

fixes.key: The podcast directory sent an answer TextMouth can't read. Try again later.
fixes.english: The podcast directory sent an answer TextMouth can't read. Try again later.
fixes.before: Direktori podcast mengirim jawaban yang tidak dapat dibaca TextMouth. Coba lagi nanti.
fixes.after: Direktori podcast mengirim respons yang tidak dapat dibaca TextMouth. Coba lagi nanti.
fixes.why: natural: a server sends a respons; jawaban is a person answering, and merespons is used elsewhere

fixes.key: The podcast directory's answer is larger than TextMouth reads.
fixes.english: The podcast directory's answer is larger than TextMouth reads.
fixes.before: Jawaban direktori podcast lebih besar dari yang dibaca TextMouth.
fixes.after: Respons direktori podcast lebih besar dari yang dibaca TextMouth.
fixes.why: natural: a server sends a respons; jawaban is a person answering, and merespons is used elsewhere

fixes.key: The recording couldn't be saved: %@ It is kept; choose %@ or %@.
fixes.english: The recording couldn't be saved: %1$@ It is kept; choose %2$@ or %3$@.
fixes.before: Rekaman tidak dapat disimpan: %1$@ Rekaman tetap disimpan; pilih %2$@ atau %3$@.
fixes.after: Rekaman tidak dapat disimpan: %1$@ Rekaman masih ada; pilih %2$@ atau %3$@.
fixes.why: meaning: tetap disimpan right after tidak dapat disimpan read as a contradiction; the recording is still there

fixes.key: There are no subscriptions to export: every feed in your library is unsubscribed.
fixes.english: There are no subscriptions to export: every feed in your library is unsubscribed.

fixes.after: Tidak ada langganan untuk diekspor: semua feed di pustaka Anda tidak lagi dilanggan.
fixes.why: grammar: a feed is subscribed to, not a subscriber; tidak berlangganan made the feed the one subscribing

fixes.key: This book's audio could not be converted from Ogg to AAC. TextMouth tries again the next time it starts.
fixes.english: This book's audio could not be converted from Ogg to AAC. TextMouth tries again the next time it starts.
fixes.before: Audio buku ini tidak dapat dikonversi dari Ogg ke AAC. TextMouth akan mencoba lagi saat dimulai berikutnya.
fixes.after: Audio buku ini tidak dapat dikonversi dari Ogg ke AAC. TextMouth akan mencoba lagi saat peluncuran berikutnya.
fixes.why: natural: saat dimulai berikutnya is a calque; the catalog says saat peluncuran berikutnya

fixes.key: This comic book archive holds more than the %@ pictures TextMouth reads.
fixes.english: This comic book archive holds more than the %@ pictures TextMouth reads.
fixes.before: Arsip buku komik ini berisi lebih dari %@ gambar yang dibaca TextMouth.
fixes.after: Arsip buku komik ini berisi lebih dari %@ gambar, batas yang dapat dibaca TextMouth.
fixes.why: meaning: the old text read as more than N pictures TextMouth did read; N is the most it reads

fixes.key: Type a podcast's title or publisher, then press Return to search Apple's directory

fixes.after: Ketik judul atau penerbit podcast, lalu tekan Return untuk mencari di direktori Apple.
fixes.why: meaning: the hint tells the listener what to do; the third-person form said the field itself types and presses Return

fixes.english: the server sent no answer
fixes.before: server tidak mengirim jawaban
fixes.after: server tidak mengirim respons
fixes.why: natural: a server sends a respons; jawaban is a person answering, and merespons is used elsewhere

fixes.english: the top of your library
fixes.before: bagian teratas pustaka Anda
fixes.after: tingkat atas pustaka Anda
fixes.why: term: the glossary calls the library root Tingkat Atas Pustaka; bagian teratas reads as the top of a list

fixes.english: “%@” is already being added to the library.

fixes.english: “%@” is still working. Quit once the change is done.
